function.name: travel_itinerary_generator
function.description: Generate a travel itinerary based on specific destination, duration and daily budget, with preferred exploration type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

days.description: Number of days for the trip.

daily_budget.description: The maximum daily budget for the trip.
